Cubism Core 6.0 for this model (MOC3 header version 06) is NOT included.
`npm install` fetches it automatically from Live2D's official URL:
https://cubism.live2d.com/sdk-web/core/06/live2dcubismcore.min.js
If the local copy is absent, the browser attempts the same official host.
Core is proprietary under the Live2D software license. Do not include Core in your Git commit.
The open-source live2d-web renderer is installed by npm and bundled by Vite.
